title: Fill to a setpoint with an analog transmitter
summary: Use the 4-20 mA level transmitter instead of a level switch: scale the raw analog value to percent and stop filling at 60 %.
objectives: Scale a raw analog value to engineering units
starterProgram:
PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL; (* Start button S1 (normally open). *)
    StopPB : BOOL; (* Stop button S2 (normally closed: TRUE while not pressed). *)
    LevelLow : BOOL; (* TRUE while the level is below the low switch (LSL-104 contact closes when dry). *)
    LevelHigh : BOOL; (* TRUE while the level is at or above the high switch (LSH-103 contact closes when wet). *)
    InletOpen : BOOL; (* Inlet valve fully-open limit switch. *)
    LevelRaw : INT; (* Raw analog value of LT-105 (scaling depends on the selected platform profile). *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    InletValve : BOOL; (* Inlet valve solenoid XV-101: TRUE opens the valve. *)
    DrainPump : BOOL; (* Drain pump P-102 contactor. *)
    LevelPercent : REAL; (* Level 0..100 % computed from LevelRaw *)
    HighAlarm : BOOL; (* Level above 85 % *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Filling : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* Scale LevelRaw to LevelPercent and fill to 60 %. *)

END_PROGRAM
instructions: Compute LevelPercent (REAL, 0..100) from LevelRaw. With the generic platform profile 0..10000 corresponds to 0..100 %.
Start fills the tank; the valve closes when LevelPercent reaches 60 %.
HighAlarm is TRUE above 85 % and also closes the valve.
Stop closes the valve at any time.
hints: Compare REAL values with REAL literals such as 60.0.

criteria.title: LevelPercent matches the tank level
criteria.onFail: LevelPercent was not about 10 % while the tank was at 10 %. Check the scaling (generic profile: 0..10000 = 0..100 %).

criteria.title: The valve closes at 60 %
criteria.onFail: InletValve stayed open after the analog level reached 60 %.
